# Keyed by (file, kind), not (file, line, kind): an edit to a baselined file that
# shifts line numbers without changing how many times a pattern occurs there must
# not turn this red. Shrinks as occurrences are moved to a real file or fixed;
# grows only with a reviewed reason, never silently.
#
# THE EXCEPTIONS — entries that are NOT backlog and will never shrink to zero. They
# are written from this script rather than by hand because --update regenerates this
# whole header, so a note added to the file would be lost on the next run.
#
#   ci/lint/no-embedded-languages{,-test}.sh — the checker's OWN doc comments naming
#     the patterns it looks for, and its test's fixture strings building a literal
#     example of each one. A pattern-matcher cannot tell 'this is a real occurrence'
#     from 'this is the string a test wrote to look like one'; that is inherent to
#     the approach. The count moves only when the test gains or loses fixture cases.
#
#   bench/ladder/bench-chart-equivalence-test.sh — the FROZEN renders of the 21

#     copy of what they rendered contains that text by definition. H2 moved the live
#     copies into clients/python/pacer_nvme_report.py and bench/lib/*.sh; this is the
#     historical record they are diffed against, and editing it to please this
#     checker would destroy the proof.
